correctness.rationale: The exact gradient gives equation (1) in RESULT.md. On the six arrangement vertices it has q-3 solutions. On each nonvertex the conic/hyperbola computation gives q-4-chi(t²-t+1), with disjoint boundary and node exclusions. The character sum is -1; the projected nodal cubic at the unique curve singularity has q+1-chi(-3) rational points, of which exactly seven are ineligible. Summation yields the complete exterior histogram and incidence moment, with all field-size/characteristic hypotheses explicit. Full enumeration at q=5,7,11,13,17,19,23,29,31,25,49,121 verified each exterior point; the all-field proof is algebraic, not inferred from those experiments.

value.rationale: The complete point-side exterior incidence spectrum is a natural exact refinement of the source tangent-filling covering problem. It gives quantitative redundancy at every exterior point in all allowed fields, explains the quadratic-character bifurcation and proves the two small fields fail only at the unique node. Unlike a routine re-count of the known set of distinct tangent lines, it classifies the complementary projection of the tangent incidence correspondence; its total incidence moment is a genuine uniform consequence. It does not purport to solve dual-curve zeta functions.
